stories.h: ICE detains two passengers on Sea-Tac jet bridge
stories.s: Immigration agents detained two people boarding an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles Saturday morning. The Port of Seattle says it is outraged and is reviewing whether protocols were broken; Gov. Ferguson called ICE out of control.

stories.h: Seattle council gives final 7-2 approval to $9.1B budget
stories.s: The council passed its amended two-year budget Friday, closing a $175M gap and keeping $352.7M for housing; Rinck and Rivera objected to one-time money for ongoing costs. Mayor Wilson has 10 days to sign or veto.

stories.h: High tides may flood South Park streets through Saturday
stories.s: Seattle Public Utilities warns of minor street flooding in South Park's industrial streets through Nov. 21, with more high-tide windows Nov. 25-29. Residents with grinder pumps should check they work.

stories.h: Space Needle gas station killing suspect extradited to Seattle
stories.s: Michael O'Neal Fleming, charged with first-degree murder in the Oct. 13 shooting of a 76 station manager, was booked into King County jail on $5M bail after extradition from Chicago.

stories.h: 14-year-old driver crashes van in Kent I-5 work zone
stories.s: WSP says a van driven by a 14-year-old hit a contractor truck and an off-duty police car near SR 516 and caught fire; the teen faces a reckless driving charge.

coming.h: Arraignment for Space Needle shooting suspect
coming.s: Michael O'Neal Fleming is set to be arraigned at the King County Courthouse on a first-degree murder charge.
